name: CDROM Le Noirmont
notes: CDROM lists Swiss data centers at Sous-la-Velle 14, Le Noirmont and Place des Sciences 1, Courroux; Data Center Map identifies Le Noirmont as a Tier 3 ISO27001 data center.

name: CDROM Courroux / Delemont Data Center
notes: CDROM's official site lists a second Jura data center at Place des Sciences 1, CH-2822 Courroux, described as the Delemont site.

name: Data Center Stollen Lucerne
notes: Official site says the Stollen Lucerne data center belongs to and is operated by ewl; DCD reports TÜViT TSI certification and lake-water-cooled CO2-neutral operation.

name: CKW Datacenter LuZ Luzern Nord
notes: CKW official location list includes Datacenter LuZ Luzern Nord; CKW Fiber Services describes offering datacenter and connectivity services from its own data centers.

name: CKW Datacenter LuZ Luzern Mitte
notes: CKW official location list includes Datacenter LuZ Luzern Mitte; HostSwiss also lists CKW Luzern DC (LuZ mitte).

name: CKW DC LuZ Luzern Ost / Rathausen
notes: CKW lists Datacenter LuZ Luzern Ost and Rathausen locations; PeeringDB places CKW DC Rathausen at Rathausen 1, Emmen; Inflect reports 1.0 MW power capacity.

name: CKW Colo Sursee
notes: CKW official site lists Colocation Sursee; Data Center Map identifies CKW Colo Sursee at Geuenseestrasse 44, Schenkon.

name: CKW Colo Wolhusen
notes: CKW official location list includes Colocation Wolhusen; Data Center Map nearby-facilities listing places CKW Colo Wolhusen in the Lucerne canton area.

name: CKW Colo Hochdorf
notes: CKW official location list includes Colocation Hochdorf; Data Center Map nearby-facilities listing identifies CKW Colo Hochdorf.

name: SIEN Data Center Cadolles
notes: Neuchatel government announced inauguration of the Cadolles 9 data center on 2024-12-16; DCD reports CHF22.5m investment, 3,230 sqm building and 1,250 sqm data center area.

name: SIEN La Chaux-de-Fonds Jardiniere Data Center
notes: 2018 city/canton communication planned two modern machine rooms, one at Cadolles and one at La Chaux-de-Fonds (Jardiniere 157); 2024 coverage says Cadolles will operate in tandem with the La Chaux-de-Fonds site.

name: High DC La Chaux-de-Fonds
notes: High DC official site gives Allée des Défricheurs 4, CH-2300 La Chaux-de-Fonds; directories describe the site as a 2019 local data center using free cooling.

name: EWN Datencenter Nidwalden
notes: EWN official telecommunications page offers secure monitored data center space in the canton of Nidwalden.

name: ILZ Rechenzentrum Nidwalden
notes: ILZ officially operates IT for the Obwalden and Nidwalden cantonal administrations and municipalities; a public annual report notes a NAS commissioned in the Nidwalden data center.

name: ILZ Rechenzentrum Obwalden
notes: ILZ is headquartered in Sarnen and operates IT for Obwalden and Nidwalden; a public annual report references central communications components in the Obwalden data center.

name: Vocom Redundant Rechenzentrum Obwalden
notes: Vocom marketing for managed backup states that its redundant data center in Canton Obwalden provides high security standards for customer data.

name: Internet Group Datacenter 1 Widnau / Heerbrugg
notes: DataCenterPlatform lists Internet Group Datacenter 1 at Espenstrasse 137, 9443 Widnau; Inflect lists the facility in the St. Gallen data center market as IG Internet Group DC1 in Heerbrugg.

name: Elektrizitaets- und Wasserwerk der Stadt Buchs SG Facility
developer: Elektrizitaets- und Wasserwerk der Stadt Buchs SG
notes: Inflect lists a Buchs SG data center/interconnection facility at Grunaustrasse 31; Newby and PeeringDB corroborate Buchs SG as an interconnection/peering facility.

name: St.Galler Stadtwerke Steinachstrasse Data Center
notes: DataCenterPlatform lists a St.Galler Stadtwerke data center location at UW Steinach, Steinachstrasse 49, 9000 St. Gallen; limited corroborating detail found.

name: STACK ZUR02 Beringen
notes: STACK announced a Beringen campus in 2021; Generis and MBA Projektmanagement identify the ZUR02 project as a 36 MW data center in Beringen, canton Schaffhausen, planned to enter operation around autumn 2026.

name: City of Winterthur Schaffhausen Data Center
notes: DCD reported that the city of Winterthur's data center in Schaffhausen was contaminated during works, delaying a planned migration effort.

name: data11 Data Center
notes: Official data11 site says it is the first carrier-neutral data center in Solothurn, built and run by BSE Software GmbH, with more than 500 sqm of Tier III data center floor.

name: Kanton Schwyz Rechenzentrum
notes: Axians case study describes a self-managed data center solution for the Canton of Schwyz; 2025 public tender Q&A states operation of the solution and data occurs in the Canton of Schwyz data center.

name: Arthur Weber AG Modern Datacenter
notes: Arthur Weber AG reports replacing its existing headquarters data center with a modern data center for business-critical IT applications; exact MW and external colocation availability not stated.

name: Datacenter Thurgau
notes: EKT official site and contact page identify Datacenter Thurgau at Galgenholzstrasse 23, Frauenfeld; Swiss IT Magazine reported the EKT facility opened in 2018 after eight months of construction.
